Specification: This module contains TLAPS proofs for a CRDT specification imported from the module CRDT. It proves safety-style results such as type correctness, an invariant called Safety, and a monotonicity property, and then develops a natural-number-valued termination measure based on the disagreement between nodes' replicated counters. Using that measure together with fairness assumptions for the Gossip action, it proves convergence/liveness results showing that under fair gossip all nodes eventually agree on the counter values.
TheoremNames: THEOREM TypeCorrect == Spec => []TypeOK
THEOREM Safe == Spec => []Safety
THEOREM Spec => Monotonicity

LEMMA SumType ==
  ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat]
  PROVE  Sum(f) \in Nat

LEMMA SumIsZero ==
  ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat]
  PROVE  Sum(f) = 0 <=> \A x \in Node : f[x] = 0

LEMMA SumWeaklyMonotonic ==
  ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat], NEW g \in [Node -> Nat],
         \A x \in Node : f[x] <= g[x]
  PROVE  Sum(f) <= Sum(g)

LEMMA SumStronglyMonotonic ==
  ASSUME NEW f \in [Node -> Nat], NEW g \in [Node -> Nat],
         \A x \in Node : f[x] <= g[x],
         \E x \in Node : f[x] < g[x]
  PROVE  Sum(f) < Sum(g)

LEMMA MeasureType ==
  ASSUME TypeOK, Safety
  PROVE  /\ \A o \in Node : DistFun(o) \in [Node -> Nat]
         /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o) \in Nat
         /\ Measure \in Nat

LEMMA MeasureTypePrime ==
  ASSUME TypeOK', Safety'
  PROVE  /\ \A o \in Node : DistFun(o)' \in [Node -> Nat]
         /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o)' \in Nat
         /\ Measure' \in Nat

LEMMA MeasureIsZero ==
  ASSUME TypeOK, Safety
  PROVE  /\ \A o \in Node : Distance(o) = 0 
                 <=> \A n \in Node : counter[o][n] = counter[n][n]
         /\ Measure = 0
            <=> \A v,w,n \in Node : counter[v][n] = counter[w][n]

LEMMA GossipDoesntIncreaseMeasure ==
  ASSUME TypeOK, TypeOK', Safety, Safety',
         [\E n,o \in Node : Gossip(n,o)]_vars
  PROVE  /\ \A v,w \in Node : DistFun(v)'[w] <= DistFun(v)[w]
         /\ \A v \in Node : Distance(v)' <= Distance(v)
         /\ Measure' <= Measure

LEMMA GossipDecreasesMeasure ==
  ASSUME TypeOK, TypeOK', Safety, Safety',
         <<\E n,o \in Node : Gossip(n,o)>>_vars
  PROVE  Measure' < Measure

LEMMA EnabledGossip ==
  ASSUME NEW n \in Node, NEW o \in Node, TypeOK
  PROVE  (ENABLED <<Gossip(n,o)>>_vars) <=>
         \E v \in Node : counter[o][v] < counter[n][v]
THEOREM OGLiveness == OGSpec => <>(\A n, o \in Node : counter[n] = counter[o])
